findings.quote_bytes:
§3 line 82: 'The owner grant relaxes EXACTLY these axes, for THIS program only:' | §3 lines 104-105: 'R1 net expectancy > 0, R2/R3/R5/
R6 control-out-earn rules' | NG6 §6 lines 273-274: 'R4  reversal reduction        C-REVERSAL-PLAIN out-earns OR reproduces
                              >= 0.5x same-sign >= 2/3 folds -> REJECT'
findings.why_wrong: The search battery (§6: R0, R1, R2, R3 C-COMPLEMENT, R4 component-only, R5 clock, K6) silently drops the direct predecessor's only scored reversal-falsification rule — NG6-R4, the C-REVERSAL-PLAIN out-earn/reproduce kill — and no control book for it exists anywhere in the plan (controls are C-COMPLEMENT, C-RANDOM-TIMING, C-CAL-HIST, C-MARKET, C-DELAY-H, C-PIT-MUTATION, C-NULL-VALIDITY; the EVENT-UNWIND complement is 'raw breakdown without reclaim', the component-only book is 'range+participation filter-only' — neither is a reversal book). This is a battery-composition change beyond the three granted axes, yet §3 asserts the grant relaxes 'EXACTLY these axes' and its NOT-relaxed ledger enumerates 'R2/R3/R5/R6' — a list that under this plan's own §6 numbering cites an R6 that does not exist (clock is R5; there is no R6) and omits R4, while under NG6 numbering it skips exactly the one dropped rule. The weakening is material and one-sided: §3 explicitly re-admits the NG6 reversal-shadow forms at 0.201-0.260 through the relaxed 0.30 floor, so a reversal-selected candidate (the EVENT-UNWIND anchor class is, per NG6 §2, 'structurally reversal-SELECTED') can now pass pre-score on a threshold its killer form measured 0.201-0.320 against, and then face NO scored reversal falsification — in NG6 both lines existed (BINDING shadows at 0.20 AND the C-REVERSAL-PLAIN scored kill). Any STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY outcome would therefore overstate what was cleared relative to the battery the plan advertises as intact, and scored cells can be consumed by candidates NG6's battery would have killed. Under a plan whose own remediation standard (§2) demands explicit attribution and disclosure of every axis of the grant, an undisclosed removal of a lineage kill rule is conclusion-changing.
findings.required_remediation: Either (a) reinstate the reversal-reduction kill for reversal-adjacent families (at minimum EVENT-UNWIND: a C-REVERSAL-PLAIN-class book with the NG6-R4 out-earn/>=0.5x same-sign >=2/3 folds form), or (b) disclose the removal as an explicit fourth axis in the §3 ledger with the same instantiation-attribution and boundedness discipline as §2, so the owner grant visibly covers it. In both cases renumber the §3 NOT-relaxed rule list to this plan's own battery (R0-R5 + K6) so the ledger and §6 agree.
